policy: Conservative whole-file count: mixed trusted/untrusted files count in full. Count is the current end-to-end compiler correctness boundary, larger than the logical proof kernel. Excludes diagnostic/error-only types, module reexports, proof-producing derive/theory, audit-only classical dependency discovery, proof search, parsers/store and both interpreters/projection. Rust toolchain, registered native implementations and explicit foreign specifications remain external assumptions. Limits metadata is resource policy, not a source of accepted evidence. Canonical-model and Nat proof construction remain untrusted and kernel-checked; exact normal-return arithmetic facts and proof-directed check elimination are covered by the existing exec checker and erasure/emission entries. Model proof construction is kernel-checked, but its handling of module privacy is counted as a mixed compiler boundary.
